patterns.name: actualOuter
patterns.application: SourcePruningEnumerationOuter.narrow_pending_complete holeKey fits admits metadata heap before readAfter entry readFuel uv oldHandle scs ready realized total observed entered

fields.name: narrowed
fields.type: SourcePruningOuterNarrow.narrow holeKey fits admits metadata nativeFuel uv oldValue heap = .done result nextHeap

fields.name: stable
fields.type: ∀ extra : Nat, SourcePruningOuterNarrow.narrow holeKey fits admits metadata (nativeFuel + extra) uv oldValue heap = .done result nextHeap

fields.name: emptyBranch
fields.type: result = .empty → ¬ ∃ final : EnumerationState.State Symbol EnumGuard, Success (reject : EnumerateM Symbol EnumGuard Unit) entry () final

fields.name: equalBranch
fields.type: result ≠ .empty → newHandle = oldHandle → result = oldValue ∧ Success (pure () : EnumerateM Symbol EnumGuard Unit) entry () entry

fields.name: changedBranch
fields.type:
result ≠ .empty → newHandle ≠ oldHandle →
  ∃ (root size rereadFuel : Nat) (rereadAfter final : EnumerationState.State Symbol EnumGuard),
    UnionFind.Reaches before.representatives uv root size ∧
    Success (representative rereadFuel uv) entry root rereadAfter ∧
    Frame entry rereadAfter ∧ Frame before rereadAfter ∧
    rereadAfter.values[root]? = some (.unenumerated (some oldHandle) scs) ∧
    root < rereadAfter.values.length ∧ PendingRealized nextHeap rereadAfter ∧
    Success (setValue root (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs)) rereadAfter () final ∧
    final = {rereadAfter with values := rereadAfter.values.set root (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs)} ∧
    final.values[root]? = some (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs) ∧ PendingRealized nextHeap final ∧
    Success (representative rereadFuel uv >>= fun selected =>
      setValue selected (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs)) entry () final

patterns.name: equalEffects
patterns.scope: equal branch after nonempty and sameHandle

fields.name: equalSuccess
fields.type: Success (pure () : EnumerateM Symbol EnumGuard Unit) entry () entry

patterns.name: changedEffects
patterns.scope: changed branch after nonempty and changedHandle

fields.name: secondRead
fields.type: Success (representative rereadFuel uv) entry root rereadAfter

fields.name: written
fields.type: Success (setValue root (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs)) rereadAfter () final

fields.name: finalShape
fields.type: final = {rereadAfter with values := rereadAfter.values.set root (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs)}

fields.name: boundRun
fields.type: Success (representative rereadFuel uv >>= fun selected => setValue selected (.unenumerated (some newHandle) scs)) entry () final

same_witness_rule: The prepare equation in changed uses the obtained rereadFuel, rereadAfter, final, result and nextHeap. No second completion or representative success assumption.
